lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular maxima are arranged in distinct vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, positioned posterior to the branchial region on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to form a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high luminance above to shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct commensal organism (remora) is visible as an elongated silhouette positioned near the posterior insertion of the pectoral fin.
